canonical_question: Does the use of the revised PBE functional adequately capture the magnetic interactions in a system with spin polarization applied?

question_variants.question: Does the use of the revised PBE functional adequately capture the magnetic interactions in a system with spin polarization applied?
question_variants.resolution_summary: The text confirms the use of the revised PBE functional with spin polarization, but does not provide an assessment or data on whether this functional adequately captures magnetic interactions in the specific system.

answers.answer: The study used 'the revised Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) [62] gradient approximation to the exchange-correlation functional' and states 'We applied spin polarization,' but does not validate the adequacy of PBE for capturing magnetic interactions in this system.
answers.conditions: VASP with PAW/PBE, spin polarization applied
answers.measurement_outcome: PBE functional used with spin polarization
answers.boundary_limitation: No assessment of functional accuracy for magnetic interactions provided
evidence_spans: The CALPHAD approach [38] – [40] is currently the only method that can be used to obtain multicomponent phase diagrams with enough accuracy for practical applications without the need of the heavy experimental work [41] .

source_evidence_spans: Projector augmented-wave (PAW) potentials [61] and the revised Perdew–Burke–Ernzerhof (PBE) [62] gradient approximation to the exchange-correlation functional were used. We applied spin polarization
